subject: Deposit deduction
body:
Hello,

We have been notified that part of our deposit will be withheld due to the condition of the returned equipment. Our understanding has always been that deposits are fully refundable regardless of the equipment's condition on return. We have been renting from you for years and this has never been raised before.

We expect the full deposit to be returned.

Nostopalvelu Karjula Oy
